verdict.rationale: Cursor is itself a coding agent, so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents as an MCP server is a different product role. The evidence documents only client-side MCP: connecting to external servers, a marketplace, and JSON config. The probe confirms no hosted MCP server exists (mcp.cursor.com NXDOMAIN), and ACP over stdio is a different protocol, not an MCP server mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
